result.instructions: Tools for FieldClimate, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "What were the daily air temperatures at my weather station last week?"; "How much rain did each of my stations record in the last 7 days?"; "Which fields and crop zones are on my farms, and what crops are planted?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes FieldClimate data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run fieldclimate_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run fieldclimate_request_feature to record the request. Paid plans: Pro (10,000 tool calls a month, $9/month or $90/year, for normal use) and Pro+ (100,000 tool calls a month, $39/month or $390/year, for automations and heavy use). A plan can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run fieldclimate_upgrade without a plan: it returns both plans, each with a payment link for the user to open. fieldclimate_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_user
tools.title: Get account
tools.description: The FieldClimate account of the API key: username, company, address and settings. GET /user.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_sensor_catalog
tools.title: List sensor types
tools.description: The FieldClimate sensor catalogue: sensor codes, names and units, for reading station sensor data. GET /system/sensors.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_crops
tools.title: List crops
tools.description: The crops known to FieldClimate, for crop zones. GET /system/crops.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_stations
tools.title: List stations
tools.description: All weather stations and devices linked to the account, with names, positions and rights. GET /user/stations.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station
tools.title: Get station
tools.description: One station: name, position, rights, configuration and dates. GET /station/{stationId}.

stationId.description: Device (station) ID from fieldclimate_list_stations, for example an 8-character device ID.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_station_sensors
tools.title: List station sensors
tools.description: The sensors of one station, with names, units and calibration. GET /station/{stationId}/sensors.

stationId.description: Device (station) ID from fieldclimate_list_stations, for example an 8-character device ID.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station_data_range
tools.title: Get data range
tools.description: The first and last dates with data for one station. Use it before a data read to see if new data arrived. GET /data/{stationId}.

stationId.description: Device (station) ID from fieldclimate_list_stations, for example an 8-character device ID.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_last_station_data
tools.title: Get recent station data
tools.description: Station measurements for the last period (for example 24h or 7d) in one data group. GET /data/{stationId}/{dataGroup}/last/{timePeriod}.

stationId.description: Device (station) ID from fieldclimate_list_stations, for example an 8-character device ID.

dataGroup.description: Data group: raw, hourly, daily or monthly.

timePeriod.description: How far back to read from now: for example 24h, 7d, 2w or 3m.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_station_data_period
tools.title: Get station data for a period
tools.description: Station measurements between two unix timestamps (seconds) in one data group. The vendor tier limits the history. GET /data/{stationId}/{dataGroup}/from/{from}/to/{to}.

stationId.description: Device (station) ID from fieldclimate_list_stations, for example an 8-character device ID.

dataGroup.description: Data group: raw, hourly, daily or monthly.

from.description: Start of the period: unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

to.description: End of the period: unix timestamp in seconds (UTC).

annotations.title: Get station data for a period

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_farms
tools.title: List farms
tools.description: All farms of the account. GET /farms.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_farm
tools.title: Get farm
tools.description: One farm of the account. GET /farms/{farmID}.

farmID.description: Farm ID (24 hex characters) from fieldclimate_list_farms.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_farm_fields
tools.title: List farm fields
tools.description: The fields of one farm. GET /farms/{farmID}/fields.

farmID.description: Farm ID (24 hex characters) from fieldclimate_list_farms.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_fields
tools.title: List fields
tools.description: All fields of the account, across farms. GET /fields.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_field
tools.title: Get field
tools.description: One field: name, farm and boundary data. GET /fields/{fieldID}.

fieldID.description: Field ID (24 hex characters) from fieldclimate_list_fields or fieldclimate_list_farm_fields.

tools.name: fieldclimate_list_crop_zones
tools.title: List crop zones
tools.description: All crop zones of the account: crops, sowing and harvest dates, and soil data. GET /crop-zones.

tools.name: fieldclimate_get_crop_zone
tools.title: Get crop zone
tools.description: One crop zone: crop, dates, boundary, soil and irrigation events. GET /crop-zones/{cropzoneID}.

cropzoneID.description: Crop zone ID (24 hex characters) from fieldclimate_list_crop_zones.
